Subject: Implementing CCPAP Module in Current A/c No. 02.

Reference: Head Office circular No.Bkg.1(11)10/New Process/Vol.II/406 dated
15.10.2015 placed at Sl. No.434 of EPFO Website.

Sir /Madam,

The CCPAP Module for payment has been implemented in A/c No. 1, 10 &
21 in all offices to prevent frauds.

2. Now, it has been decided to replicate CCPAP Module in Current A/c No. 02
at all field offices. For this purpose issuing Type-29 cheques in Current A/c No. 02 is
required. SBI, Corporate Centre, Mumbai has made a concern that inasmuch as all the
accounts of A/c NO.02 have been opened recently, only MCC type 29 would have been
issued to all offices. It is, therefore, requested to ensure and confirm that Type 29 cheque
leaves are issued by the Bank in Current A/c No. 02.

The launch date of implementation of CCPAP Module in A/c No. 02
is 10.03.2016 for all offices.

8 The Offices may generate digitally signed CCPAP file and upload the
same to SBI SFTP server on 10.03.2016 itself. The file of 10.03.2016 will
contain the data of Type 29 cheques issued from current A/c No.02 during
preceding three months’ period and the cheques issued on 10.03.2016.
Thereafter, the CCPAP file will be uploaded on a daily basis.

otal afass fe a4 Fax: 011-26173022

Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation Telephone: 26172685

4. The Offices may be in readiness with the details of cheques issued
during the preceding three months priod to 10.03.2016 for uploading. For any
technical issue in roll out of CCPAP may be taken with Shri S.K. Panda,
DD(IS) at NDC and the issues related to Bank with Shri M.S. Negi, AGM, SBI
& Nodal Officer for EPFO.

5. APFC (Cash) at ROs/SROs may ensure uploading of digitally signed
file of CCPAP to SBI SFTP Server on 10.03.2016 (containing details of
preceding three months) and thereafter on a daily basis. RPFC-II (F&A) posted
at Regional Offices and RPFC-II-Incharge of Sub-Regional Offices shall
ensure that the cheques issued in A/c No.02 during the day are uploaded
through CCPAP file at the end of the day. For this, a link
http://banking.epfoservices.org/CCPAP/ has been provided for monitoring the
status of CCPAP.

Yours faithfully
